messages:
kevin: opened PR 964 — added a focused guide for private VPC installs that need offline KMS enrollment and HSM provisioning. goal: concise steps + minimal examples. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/964 :memo:
mira: thanks. can you add an explicit "enroll-key" flow for customers who bring their own HSM and do a one-time CSR upload? we got questions last week.
oz: add a small cert/CSR example and the curl invocation that talks to the control plane endpoint (use a placeholder URL). also include the API contract: POST /v1/hsm/enroll -> returns job id, poll via GET /v1/hsm/enroll/{id}.
kevin: added a short curl example and an excerpted response. kept it high level and non-sensitive.
rachael: security note: document must say clearly not to store private keys on installer media. add an HSM-backed key rotation caveat (how long before rotation requires reconnect).
kevin: added note about rotation windows and that HSM-backed keys may require an out-of-band rotation window of 48–72h for offline sites.
ci-bot: lint: docs PR 964 queued; running linkcheck + spellcheck. :gear:
mira: small wording nit: replace "control plane" with "private control plane" in the enroll example to avoid confusion for dedicated customers.
kevin: done. pushing update. tagging reviewers: @mira @oz @rachael. can someone smoke test the curl example? just copy/paste with placeholder host.
rachael: will try later. minor: add a short troubleshooting bullet for enrollment failure: common causes are outbound TLS block, incorrect system clock, and PKCS11 label mismatch.
kevin: added troubleshooting bullets. planning to merge after CI + one reviewer ack. :+1:
